name: Barley Pomegranate Bowl
ingredients: ¼ cup chopped mint and parsley
Dressing: 2 tsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, ½ tsp cumin, salt and pepper
steps: Boil the barley in plenty of water for 30 minutes until tender; drain and cool.
Toss the barley, chickpeas, cucumber and herbs with the dressing.
Top with the tofu and pomegranate seeds.
note: Barley contains beta-glucan, a soluble fibre studied for its effect on LDL cholesterol.
